{3: 'The sounds of combat tear through the polar wind as green and red auroras writhe violently overhead. Mina swings her ice-breaking hammer, crushing a Corrupted to the ground. Though its head is slick with black mechanical oil, her grin only sharpens, wild and feral.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLouDianNew.prefab', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mina', 3: "With this array boosting me, I'm unstoppable! Let me show you the real power of my Arctic relic—this ice-breaker!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Dr. Bear', 3: "What are you doing, Dr. Mina? The array isn't calibrated for humans! Stay put and don't move!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mina', 3: 'Are you nuts? You expect me to just stand here as target practice?', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Ignoring a panicked Dr. Bear, Mina backhands another Corrupted into the frozen sea and immediately opens her comms channel.'}
{2: 'Mina', 3: 'Hey, Asimov. Cut to the chase, what is this "Amalgamation" tech, really?', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '3', 3: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Is now really the best moment for a theoretical discussion?', 4: '2'}

{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '2'}

{2: 'Dr. Bear', 3: "Time to feel this Ursa's fury, Punishing Virus!", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Mina', 3: 'Alright, out with it! I hate being kept in the dark!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The Chief Technician lets out a sigh.'}

{2: 'Asimov', 3: "I'll send you a detailed report later, but put simply, Amalgamation technology is a bridge connecting individual M.I.N.D.s. Its ultimate objective is to construct a vast consciousness network: the Amalgamation array.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mina', 3: "I saw that much firsthand. Everyone linked gets a massive power boost... even starts using tech they shouldn't understand.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Asimov', 3: "It's not just enhancement. It is completion. We previously misidentified the instability in the Arctic Route Union's humanoid-hybrid M.I.N.D.s as a flaw. In reality, it was a deliberate design gap.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mina', 3: 'Are you saying they engineered humanoid-hybrids specifically for Amalgamation?', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Asimov', 3: "Correct. Bionic machines possess dedicated Amalgamation access points. Non-humanoid collectives induce M.I.N.D. instability, but these perceived defects perfectly complement Amalgamation's requirements.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: "The technology's purpose is to construct a macro-array from countless individual nodes, recalibrating each unique entity—from individual to collective, and back again.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mina', 3: 'So after the Amalgamation, they become "complete"... That explains the historical obsession with perfecting humanoid-hybrid frames.', 4: '1'}

{3: '"Ultimate Amalgamator Malkuth"—a term Mina recalls from the manuscript during her talk with Asimov. This, she now understands, is the key. "Complete" doesn\'t just mean the Amalgamator is finished; it means the entire system, including its subordinate frames, is now whole.'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: "Shared consciousness, mutual reinforcement—that is the true purpose of Amalgamation's power. A communal existence defines Malkuth's core strength.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mina', 3: "But if that's the ideal... what's with the red aurora? What kind of Amalgamation is the Frostheart Emperor running?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'A corrupted variant.', 4: '2'}

{2: 'Asimov', 3: "Similar to Amberia's prior misuse, while she employed the power of Amalgamation, her core methodology was appropriation, subsuming other nodes within the array as mere extensions of her own will.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mina', 3: "But wouldn't that break the proper connection between the Amalgamator, the humanoid-hybrids, and the bionic machines?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Connection is not the requirement. He only needs to activate the combat modules.', 4: '2'}

{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Immersion in anger teaches hatred, a principle applicable to any thinking entity. Complex consciousness synchronization is unnecessary. Implanting a single, dominant emotion or command suffices.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mina', 3: "No synchronization needed... Wait, so he doesn't need an anchor like Derek in our case...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Indeed. I suspect our initial activation failure was within his anticipated parameters.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mina', 3: 'Hmph. Too bad for him we got it working in the end... Speaking of which, what exactly did you connect to handle the processing load?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'A large-scale server cluster, provided by an associate who operates under the designation "The Unwinged".', 4: '2'}
